process.title: How it works

steps.title: Briefing
steps.description: We discuss the problem, your audience and what you want to achieve.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.description: We agree on the project scope, timeline and budget.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: I build the solution in stages and share progress for review.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: We validate the solution together and I walk you through how to use it.

process.supportDescription: After delivery, support can include updates, fixes and monitoring, depending on what we agree for the project.

brief.intro: A project can start with a problem, a sketch or an idea still taking shape. Tell me what you have in mind and we can talk about what to build.
brief.title: Share your idea
brief.name: Name
brief.ideaPlaceholder: What problem would you like to solve, and who would use it?
brief.referencesPlaceholder: Links, prototypes or examples that help explain your idea
brief.review: You can review the message in WhatsApp before sending it.
brief.copyHint: Copy the message to share your idea.
brief.requiresJavaScript: Enable JavaScript to fill out the form.

offers.title: Company website
offers.description: Introduce your business, show what you do and give customers a clear way to get in touch.

offers.title: Landing page
offers.description: Focus a campaign or product launch on one action, from requesting a quote to joining a waitlist.

offers.title: Online store
offers.description: Organize your products and give customers a straightforward path from browsing to checkout.

offers.title: Custom ERP
offers.description: Bring orders, inventory and day-to-day operations into one system shaped around your workflow.

offers.title: Internal portal
offers.description: Give your team a place to manage requests, approvals and reports with the right permissions.

offers.title: Customer app
offers.description: Let customers book, place orders or manage their accounts from their phones.

offers.title: Field app
offers.description: Help teams record visits, complete checklists and update work orders on the move.

offers.title: Workflow automation
offers.description: Turn repetitive steps into flows that process requests, send alerts and keep records up to date.

offers.title: System integrations
offers.description: Connect tools through APIs so information moves with the work and teams enter it once.
